# Written by noevia for this task. Replaces nothing but the entries it names.
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      noevia:
        displayName: "noevia engine"
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: "http://engine-placeholder.invalid/v1"
        headers:
          Authorization: "Bearer __TASK_KEY__"
        models:
          - id: "__TASK_MODEL__"
            name: "__TASK_MODEL__"
            contextWindow: 32768
            maxTokens: 4096
            reasoningEfforts: false
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: noevia
    model: "__TASK_MODEL__"
- id: acp
  config:
    provider: noevia
    model: "__TASK_MODEL__"
- id: approval
  config:
    policy: ask
- id: sandbox-policy
  config:
    mode: workspace-write
    workspaceRoot: !!js process.cwd()
- id: session-telemetry-otel
  disabled: true
- id: session-log-deepseek
  disabled: true
- id: web-search-deepseek
  disabled: true
- id: llm-deepseek
  disabled: true
- id: deepseek-account
  disabled: true
- id: plugin-manager
  disabled: true
- id: config-editor
  disabled: true
- id: settings
  disabled: true
- id: agent-instructions
  disabled: true
- id: skill-filesystem
  disabled: true
- id: tool-skill
  disabled: true
- id: skill
  disabled: true
- insert:
    - id: noevia-gate
      name: ./noevia-gate.mjs
